capabilities: Save pasted and dropped images and videos to a media folder outside the vault
Link dropped files in place without copying them
Move attachments that landed in the vault to the media folder and update links
Resize images by dragging their right edge
disambiguation: Not a cloud upload or image-hosting tool; files stay on the local computer in a folder outside the vault.
extras: Desktop only, so images do not show on mobile. The media folder is not copied by Obsidian Sync, iCloud or Git, and in-place links break if the original file is moved, renamed or deleted. README is also provided in Chinese.
problem: Images and videos kept inside the vault make it large and slow to sync and back up.
summary: Saves pasted and dropped images and videos to a folder outside the vault, links them, and stores identical files only once.
